Title: SQL Injection in Admin Panel
Description: SQL injection vulnerability found in the admin login form allowing unauthenticated users to bypass authentication
Impact Description: Attackers could gain unauthorized access to sensitive admin functions and user data
Recommendation: Implement parameterized queries and input validation. Update all database calls to use prepared statements

Title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
Description: Reflected XSS found in user search functionality that allows injection of malicious scripts
Impact Description: User sessions could be hijacked and sensitive data stolen through malicious redirects
Recommendation: Implement output encoding and Content Security Policy. Sanitize all user inputs before rendering

Title: Weak Password Policy
Description: System accepts passwords with insufficient complexity requirements (minimum 4 characters)
Impact Description: Users could have weak passwords making accounts vulnerable to brute force attacks
Recommendation: Enforce minimum 12 character passwords with uppercase, lowercase, numbers and special characters

Title: Insecure Data Storage
Description: Sensitive data including credit card numbers stored in plaintext without encryption
Impact Description: Financial and personal data could be exposed if database is breached
Recommendation: Implement AES-256 encryption for sensitive data at rest. Use HSM for key management

Title: Missing Security Headers
Description: HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options) not configured
Impact Description: Application vulnerable to various web-based attacks including clickjacking and man-in-the-middle
Recommendation: Add security headers: HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy

Title: Unencrypted API Endpoints
Description: API endpoints transmit sensitive data over unencrypted HTTP instead of HTTPS
Impact Description: Data transmitted between client and server could be intercepted and read by attackers
Recommendation: Enforce TLS 1.2+ for all API endpoints. Implement certificate pinning for mobile clients

Title: Broken Access Control
Description: Users could access other users' reports by manipulating the user_id parameter in URLs
Impact Description: Unauthorized information disclosure affecting all user reports and sensitive business data
Recommendation: Implement proper authorization checks. Use access control lists and role-based permissions

Title: Default Credentials Detected
Description: Default admin credentials found on publicly accessible management interface
Impact Description: Complete system compromise possible with default credentials remaining active
Recommendation: Change all default credentials immediately. Disable default accounts. Implement strong password policies

Title: Hardcoded Secrets in Code
Description: Database passwords and API keys hardcoded in source code visible in git history
Impact Description: Secrets exposed in version control allowing unauthorized access to backend systems
Recommendation: Remove secrets from code. Use environment variables and secrets management system (Vault/AWS Secrets Manager)
